description: Use when preparing for Japan's SME Management Consultant examination (中小企業診断士試験) — the first-stage seven subjects with subject-pass carry-over, the second-stage written case studies (組織・マーケティング・生産・財務), finance and accounting calculations, using official SME white papers and statutes, and multi-year study planning. Also use when writing or verifying practice questions for the first stage or practising case-study answers.
